title: Spring cleaning @ cynkra dev day :soap:
description:
## Mise en Place

- [x] Ask maintainer to set up access rights <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>(if acceptable -- for smoother workflow; and necessary for a few items) For repositories under a personal account refer to https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-personal-account-on-github/managing-user-account-settings/permission-levels-for-a-personal-account-repository#collaborator-access-for-a-repository-owned-by-a-personal-account and for repositories under an organization account refer to https://docs.github.com/en/organizations/managing-user-access-to-your-organizations-repositories/managing-repository-roles/repository-roles-for-an-organization (Write Access)</details>
- [x] `pak::pak("r-lib/usethis")` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Install the development version of usethis which has the Air setup function.</details>
- [x] `pak::pak("cynkra/cynkradown")` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Install our pkgdown template that has a function to set up its usage.</details>

## Quick Wins

- [x] `pr_init("upkeep-2025-06")` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Create a branch for this spring cleaning work</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_readme_rmd()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>If you didn't use a Rmd README, switch to one and port the content from README.md. If you did, please make sure it has the `<!-- badges: start -->` and `<!-- badges: end -->` comments.</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_roxygen_md()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Activate the usage of Markdown in roxygen2 comments https://roxygen2.r-lib.org/articles/rd-formatting.html</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_github_links()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Register the GitHub links in DESCRIPTION</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_pkgdown_github_pages()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Implement the GitHub setup needed to automatically publish your pkgdown site to GitHub pages</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_tidy_github_labels()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Create "tidy" issue labels https://usethis.r-lib.org/reference/use_github_labels.html#tidyverse-label-usage You might need to update the labelling of open issues.</details>
- [x] `urlchecker::url_check()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Check whether URLs are valid. Use https://urlchecker.r-lib.org/reference/url_update.html for automatic fixing of some broken URLs.</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_package_doc()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Create a package level manual page. Also use it to store imports useful for the whole page.</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_testthat(3)` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Activate testthat's third edition. https://testthat.r-lib.org/articles/third-edition.html</details>
- [x] Handle and close any still-open `master` --> `main` PRs <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>https://www.tidyverse.org/blog/2021/10/renaming-default-branch/</details>
- [x] `usethis::git_default_branch_rename()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>https://www.tidyverse.org/blog/2021/10/renaming-default-branch/</details>
- [x] Use `pak::pak("tidyverse/blob")` in README <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Better way to install packages than devtools these days.</details>
- [ ] Use R-universe installation instructions <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>For instance install.packages('blockr.ui', repos = c('https://cynkra.r-universe.dev', 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_mit_license()` : if there are external contributors, see deep dives <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>https://www.tidyverse.org/blog/2021/12/relicensing-packages/</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_tidy_description()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Clean up the formatting of DESCRIPTION</details>
- [ ] `usethis::use_github_action("check-standard")` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>GHA workflow for R CMD check, will also add a badge.</details>
- [ ] `usethis::use_github_action("test-coverage")` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary> GHA workflow for test coverage uploaded on codecov.io, will also add a badge.</details>
- [x] Delete any outdated CI configuration file <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Travis, Appveyor, old GitHub Actions workflows. Also check README badges!</details>
- [x] `usethis::use_air()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>You can also reformat files with Air</details>
- [x] `devtools::build_readme()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Build the README.Rmd with a temporary installation of the package</details>

## cynkra Quick Wins

- [ ] `cynkratemplate::use_cynkra_pkgdown()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Register the use of our awesome pkgdown template.</details>
- [ ] `cynkrathis::register_cynkra()` if cynkra is not in authors yet
- [ ] `cynkrathis:: add_cynkra_ror()` if cynkra was already in authors <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>https://ropensci.org/blog/2025/05/09/ror/</details>

## Deep Dives

- [x] Before usethis::use_mit_license(), ask external contributors if it's ok
- [ ] Align the names of R/ files and test/ files <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>https://www.tidyverse.org/blog/2022/02/upkeep-testthat-3/#corresponding-files-in-r-and-teststestthat</details>
- [x] Use lifecycle instead of artisanal deprecation messages <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/communicate.html</details>
- [ ] Use cli for messages <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>https://blog.r-hub.io/2023/11/30/cliff-notes-about-cli/</details>
- [ ] Add alt-text to pictures, plots, etc; see posit.co/blog/knitr-fig-alt for examples
- [x] Place all @import and @importFrom in the pkg doc file <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Follow a nice newish convention to find them when you look for them.</details>
- [x] If checks show notes for global variables, use `.data` and `.env` in tidyverse style functions, then if globals remain, use `roxyglobals::use_roxyglobals()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/articles/programming.html, https://tidyr.tidyverse.org/articles/programming.html, https://github.com/anthonynorth/roxyglobals</details>

## Wrap Up

- [ ] `desc::add_me()` <details><summary>:bulb:</summary>Register yourself as ctb in `DESCRIPTION`</details>
- [ ] Ask maintainer to review PR + merge + and cleanup access rights of relevant

title: Missing blob?
description:
What's the proper way to represent missingness in `blob`?

is it a `NULL` element of the list vector?

```
as_blob(NA)
```

returns `list(NULL)`

and

```
as_blob(list(NULL, as.raw(0)))
```

returns `list(NULL, as.raw(0))`

but

```
as_blob(NA_character_)
```

returns `list(charToRaw("NA"))`

Missingness is not mentioned in the help anywhere, nor in the README. Is missingness intended to be supported? Is the `as_blob(NA_character_)` result a bug?

title: Move `master` branch to `main`
description:
The `master` branch of this repository will soon be renamed to `main`, as part of a coordinated change across several GitHub organizations (including, but not limited to: [tidyverse](https://github.com/tidyverse), [r-lib](https://github.com/r-lib), [tidymodels](https://github.com/tidymodels), and [sol-eng](https://github.com/sol-eng)). We anticipate this will happen by the end of September 2021.

That will be preceded by a release of the [usethis package](https://usethis.r-lib.org), which will gain some functionality around detecting and adapting to a renamed default branch. There will also be a blog post at the time of this `master` --> `main` change.

The purpose of this issue is to:

* Help us firm up the list of targetted repositories
* Make sure all maintainers are aware of what's coming
* Give us an issue to close when the job is done
* Give us a place to put advice for collaborators re: how to adapt

*message id: euphoric_snowdog*

description:
Make it optional, to reduce dependencies of *RSQLite* and other database packages: http://dirk.eddelbuettel.com/blog/2018/02/28/#017_dependencies. Same technique as used for *hms*.

Thanks @eddelbuettel!

title: blob hex?
description:
We've had a graphic designer produce hexes for our [flobr](https://github.com/poissonconsulting/flobr) and [dbflobr](https://github.com/poissonconsulting/dbflobr) packages which depend on the blob package.

We asked him to throw a demo hex together for the blob package.

[blob-hex-v1-1.pdf](https://github.com/tidyverse/blob/files/3780550/blob-hex-v1-1.pdf)

Let us know if you are interested in using it (we'll cover the cost) and whether you want any changes to color, font etc.
